outputDir.description: Folder (relative to the project root) where the core is generated.

baseApiUrl.description: API base URL written to src/environments/environment*.ts (BASE_API_URL).

storageEngine.description: CACHE_STORAGE backend for the response cache (SSR-safe).

generateAuthInterceptor.description: Generate the auth interceptor, AuthTokenStore and AUTH_ALLOWED_URLS.

authTokenName.description: Deprecated and ignored: the auth interceptor reads AuthTokenStore.

authTokenImportPath.description: Deprecated and ignored: the auth interceptor reads AuthTokenStore.

generateErrorInterceptor.description: Generate the error interceptor (HttpErrorBus, LOGIN_ROUTE / FORBIDDEN_ROUTE redirects).

generateLoggingInterceptor.description: Generate a dev-only request logging interceptor.

generateBarrel.description: Generate services/index.ts re-exporting the core services.

generateProjectStructure.description: Generate layout/, pages/, routes/ (with authGuard) and shared/, and merge app.routes.ts.

naming.description: File/class naming: "modern" (user-card.ts, Angular v20 style guide) or "suffixed" (user-card.component.ts). Missing = "suffixed".

project.description: angular.json project to target; empty = auto-detect.
